actions.title: Backtest a simple systematic strategy, honestly
actions.description: Choose one testable hypothesis (e.g. short-term mean reversion in an index ETF). actions.evidence: Public GitHub repo + README with out-of-sample results (including negative ones).

yearGuidance.postgrad: Master's/PhD students: Jane Street states no degree requirement. Research-leaning roles reward projects with rigorous evaluation (QNT-05).

actions.title: Pro-bono consulting project for a charity, social enterprise or society
actions.description: Scope one real problem with a client (e.g. falling volunteer sign-ups). Gather data (survey, interviews), structure the issue, recommend 2-3 actions, then follow up on what was adopted and what changed.
actions.evidence: Client deck + what the client adopted and any measured change (report it as it is, including no change); CV bullet in problem → analysis → recommendation → result form (CON-03).

actions.title: Case practice log
actions.description: Run 15-20 live cases with a partner, starting with Bain's free practice cases. After each one, log your structure, maths errors and synthesis. Track improvement on the five dimensions Cambridge lists.
actions.evidence: Case log (interview readiness; not a CV line).

actions.description: Write a 6-8 slide deck on one UK sector: a market-size estimate (top-down and bottom-up), key players, one trend and what it means for a client. Then present it to a society or a peer group.
actions.evidence: Slide deck; source for 'what's a challenge facing our clients' interview answers.

actions.title: Lead a measurable improvement where you already are
actions.description: In a society, team or part-time job, take ownership of one metric (attendance, revenue, sign-ups). Diagnose it with data, run a fix, and report the before and after honestly, even if the metric did not move. Bain asks for a record of initiative, leadership and teamwork; TARGETjobs says McKinsey looks for evidence of impact.
actions.evidence: CV bullet with your real before/after numbers (e.g. 'Raised attendance from [x]% to [y]% by…'); a strong story for fit interviews.

yearGuidance.year1: Join 180DC or a consulting society, take on one leadership task with a measurable result, attend firm events (BCG London lists its events on its UK careers page), and start casual case practice with Bain's free cases.
yearGuidance.year2_penultimate: Apply for internships: Bain London ACI is expected to open Nov 2026; BCG London runs 1-24 Jan 2027. Prepare the numerical online test first, then do structured case practice (15-20 cases).
yearGuidance.final: Apply for Associate/Associate Consultant roles; check each firm's page from early autumn for its window. Lead the CV with quantified leadership and problem-solving.
yearGuidance.postgrad: Bain London accepts Master's (non-MBA) and PhD students from any discipline. BCG routes PhD and medical-degree holders to Senior Associate.
